correctness.rationale: For fixed labeled chain C_n and exactly the strong prefix-stability axioms, each target z has a predecessor initial segment 0<=a_z<=z+1, independently, giving (n+1)! relations. On any persistent upset U_k, box_R(U_k)=U_(rho(k)) where rho(k)=max_{z<k}a_z, with rho(0)=0, rho monotone and rho(k)<=k; every such Catalan map is realized by recording jumps and zero on plateaus. Two frames agree for all formulae under all common persistent valuations iff their rho profiles agree, by atom box test and induction. Relation composition produces height c_z=rho_a(b_z) and rho_c=rho_a composed rho_b. For a fixed profile, positive record-step heights are forced, plateau a_z vary independently 0..rho(z+1), so every fiber is a distributive product-of-chains interval with exact q edge enumerator. Exactly 2^n profiles have only plateaus of height zero and hence singleton fibers; no unproved leap from a finite Catalan table is needed. Independent enumeration all n=1..5 (2,6,24,120,720 actual relations) confirmed modality counts 2,5,14,42,132, singleton 2,4,8,16,32, complete graded interval descriptions. The quotient concerns box alone and a fixed labeled finite chain, not general posets or other modal semantics.
